blocks.title: Description of the 3 artists
blocks.text: 1: Nukeme: Nukeme (Nukui, 1986) is a Japanese fashion designer and artist who merges streetwear and digital glitch aesthetics. He moved to Tokyo and became a pioneer in wearable tech-art, earning recognition at the Japan Media Arts Festival for his ground-breaking Glitch Embroidery project. He opens computerized sewing machine files (.pes or embroidery binary files) in a text or hex editor and manually overwrites portions of the raw code. This corrupts the machine's instructions.
